name: The Brontë Sisters
q: It is foolish to wish for beauty
Riches I hold in light esteem
I'd rather be happy than dignified
All our talents increase in the using
Life is too short to nurse animosity
Grasp no thorn, crave no rose
Love is a wild rose; friendship, holly
We must have action, or we make it
I am no bird; no net ensnares me
His soul and mine are the same
A book's worth is not its author's sex
Eyes and ears are the heart's inlets
The heart hides treasures in silence
No unquiet sleep in that quiet earth
